name: Demo · Payment exception review
xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_PaymentReview" targetNamespace="https://pension360.example/workflows">
<bpmn:process id="PaymentReview" name="PaymentReview" isExecutable="true">
<bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Start payment assurance"><bpmn:outgoing>StartAssessment</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
<bpmn:businessRuleTask id="AssessRule" name="Run payment rule"><bpmn:incoming>StartAssessment</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>AssessmentResult</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:businessRuleTask>
<bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="StatusGateway" name="Payment result?" default="Unable"><bpmn:incoming>AssessmentResult</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Clear</bpmn:outgoing><bpmn:outgoing>Finding</bpmn:outgoing><bpmn:outgoing>Unable</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
<bpmn:endEvent id="ClearEnd" name="Payment check clear"><bpmn:incoming>Clear</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
<bpmn:userTask id="EvidenceTask" name="Restore source or request evidence"><bpmn:incoming>Unable</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>EvidenceComplete</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
<bpmn:endEvent id="EvidenceEnd" name="Assessment requires follow-up"><bpmn:incoming>EvidenceComplete</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
<bpmn:userTask id="InvestigationTask" name="Investigate payment difference"><bpmn:incoming>Finding</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>InvestigationComplete</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
<bpmn:userTask id="ReviewTask" name="Review proposed correction"><bpmn:incoming>InvestigationComplete</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>ReviewComplete</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
<bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ReviewGateway" name="Correction approved?" default="Reject"><bpmn:incoming>ReviewComplete</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Approve</bpmn:outgoing><bpmn:outgoing>Reject</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
<bpmn:endEvent id="ApprovedEnd" name="Correction review approved; no payment sent"><bpmn:incoming>Approve</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
<bpmn:endEvent id="RejectedEnd" name="Correction rejected; investigate again"><bpmn:incoming>Reject</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="StartAssessment" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="AssessRule"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AssessmentResult" sourceRef="AssessRule" targetRef="StatusGateway"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Clear" sourceRef="StatusGateway" targetRef="ClearEnd"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[{"path":"rule.status","operator":"eq","value":"CLEAR"}]]></bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Finding" sourceRef="StatusGateway" targetRef="InvestigationTask"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[{"path":"rule.status","operator":"eq","value":"FINDING"}]]></bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Unable" sourceRef="StatusGateway" targetRef="EvidenceTask"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="EvidenceComplete" sourceRef="EvidenceTask" targetRef="EvidenceEnd"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="InvestigationComplete" sourceRef="InvestigationTask" targetRef="ReviewTask"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="ReviewComplete" sourceRef="ReviewTask" targetRef="ReviewGateway"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Approve" sourceRef="ReviewGateway" targetRef="ApprovedEnd"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[{"path":"tasks.ReviewTask.decision","operator":"eq","value":"APPROVE"}]]></bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Reject" sourceRef="ReviewGateway" targetRef="RejectedEnd"></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
</bpmn:process>
<bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="Diagram_PaymentReview"><bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="Plane_PaymentReview" bpmnElement="PaymentReview">
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Start" bpmnElement="Start"><dc:Bounds x="80" y="232" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_AssessRule" bpmnElement="AssessRule"><dc:Bounds x="180" y="210" width="140" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_StatusGateway" bpmnElement="StatusGateway"><dc:Bounds x="390" y="225" width="50" height="50"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_ClearEnd" bpmnElement="ClearEnd"><dc:Bounds x="590" y="42" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EvidenceTask" bpmnElement="EvidenceTask"><dc:Bounds x="550" y="440" width="140" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EvidenceEnd" bpmnElement="EvidenceEnd"><dc:Bounds x="790" y="462" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_InvestigationTask" bpmnElement="InvestigationTask"><dc:Bounds x="550" y="210" width="140" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_ReviewTask" bpmnElement="ReviewTask"><dc:Bounds x="780" y="210" width="140" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_ReviewGateway" bpmnElement="ReviewGateway"><dc:Bounds x="1000" y="225" width="50" height="50"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_ApprovedEnd" bpmnElement="ApprovedEnd"><dc:Bounds x="1190" y="142" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_RejectedEnd" bpmnElement="RejectedEnd"><dc:Bounds x="1190" y="342" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_StartAssessment" bpmnElement="StartAssessment"><di:waypoint x="116" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="180" y="250"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_AssessmentResult" bpmnElement="AssessmentResult"><di:waypoint x="320" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="390" y="250"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Clear" bpmnElement="Clear"><di:waypoint x="440" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="515" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="515" y="60"/><di:waypoint x="590" y="60"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Finding" bpmnElement="Finding"><di:waypoint x="440" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="550" y="250"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Unable" bpmnElement="Unable"><di:waypoint x="440" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="495" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="495" y="480"/><di:waypoint x="550" y="480"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_EvidenceComplete" bpmnElement="EvidenceComplete"><di:waypoint x="690" y="480"/><di:waypoint x="790" y="480"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_InvestigationComplete" bpmnElement="InvestigationComplete"><di:waypoint x="690" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="780" y="250"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_ReviewComplete" bpmnElement="ReviewComplete"><di:waypoint x="920" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="1000" y="250"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Approve" bpmnElement="Approve"><di:waypoint x="1050" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="1120" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="1120" y="160"/><di:waypoint x="1190" y="160"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Reject" bpmnElement="Reject"><di:waypoint x="1050" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="1120" y="250"/><di:waypoint x="1120" y="360"/><di:waypoint x="1190" y="360"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
</bpmndi:BPMNPlane></bpmndi:BPMNDiagram></bpmn:definitions>
